record.question: What is the study of soils in their natural environment called?
record.explanation: Answer D: Pedology. Pedology studies soils as natural bodies, including their formation and classification. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/science/pedology. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
